segments.t: Accept Dwarven Outfitters from Sten Stoutarm

tips.text: Sten stands just outside Anvilmar. The Ragged Young Wolves are all around the starting area, so you finish this on the walk.

segments.t: Complete Dwarven Outfitters: 8 Tough Wolf Meat

tips.text: Hit every Rockjaw Trogg you pass as well; they count for A New Threat in a minute.

segments.t: Turn in Dwarven Outfitters to Sten Stoutarm, then accept Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery from him and A New Threat from Balir Frosthammer beside him
Accept Simple Rune from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Consecrated Rune from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Etched Rune from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Encrypted Rune from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Hallowed Rune from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Archaic Rune from Sten Stoutarm

tips.text: Shaman is new for Dwarves in Forever. Your trainer Teo Hammerstorm is inside Anvilmar with the others.

segments.t: Accept Simple Memorandum from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Encrypted Memorandum from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Glyphic Memorandum from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Tainted Memorandum from Sten Stoutarm
Accept Hallowed Memorandum from Sten Stoutarm

tips.text: Priest is new for Gnomes in Forever; you train with Branstock Khalder like Dwarf priests.

segments.t: Turn in Simple Rune to Thran Khorman
Turn in Consecrated Rune to Bromos Grummner
Turn in Etched Rune to Thorgas Grimson
Turn in Encrypted Rune to Solm Hargrin
Turn in Hallowed Rune to Branstock Khalder
Turn in Archaic Rune to Teo Hammerstorm
Turn in Simple Memorandum to Thran Khorman
Turn in Encrypted Memorandum to Solm Hargrin
Turn in Glyphic Memorandum to Marryk Nurribit
Turn in Tainted Memorandum to Alamar Grimm
Turn in Hallowed Memorandum to Branstock Khalder
Optional: pick up a gathering profession from the junior trainers by the Anvilmar door (mining, herbalism or skinning)

tips.text: Forever adds junior gathering trainers to the starting areas, so you can start mining, herbalism or skinning at level 1 instead of waiting for Kharanos or Ironforge.

segments.t: Complete A New Threat: 6 Rockjaw Trogg, 6 Burly Rockjaw Trogg

tips.text: Plain troggs are around the valley floor; the Burly ones sit further west toward the frozen pond.

segments.t: Turn in A New Threat to Balir Frosthammer
Turn in the mail to Talin Keeneye at his camp in the west, then accept the next delivery and The Boar Hunter
Complete The Boar Hunter: 12 Small Crag Boar

tips.text: Small Crag Boars roam the slope right behind Talin's camp.

segments.t: Turn in The Boar Hunter to Talin Keeneye
Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard at the camp south of Talin and accept The Troll Cave
Accept Scalding Mornbrew Delivery from Nori Pridedrift

tips.text: The mug of Mornbrew goes cold after five minutes. Run straight up to Anvilmar and do not stop to fight.

segments.t: Turn in Scalding Mornbrew Delivery to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar and take back the empty mug
Accept A Refugee's Quandary from Felix Whindlebolt
Accept Beginnings from Alamar Grimm

tips.text: Warlocks: the Feather Charms drop from the Frostmane Novices at the troll camp, next to Grik'nir.

segments.t: Accept Call of Earth from Teo Hammerstorm

tips.text: Shamans: the bear pendants drop from the same trolls you kill for The Troll Cave.

segments.t: Train your new level 2-4 spells
Complete The Troll Cave: 14 Frostmane Troll Whelp

tips.text: Kill the Troll Whelps around the camp before you go into the cave.

segments.t: Complete Call of Earth: 2 Iceclaw Bear Pendant
Grab Felix's Box northwest of the troll camp
Grab Felix's Chest on the west side of the troll camp
Grab Felix's Bucket of Bolts inside the troll camp
Turn in The Troll Cave to Grelin Whitebeard and accept The Stolen Journal
Complete The Stolen Journal: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

tips.text: Grik'nir the Cold waits at the back of the cave. Clear the Novices on the way in; they come in pairs.

segments.t: Complete Beginnings: 3 Feather Charm
Turn in The Stolen Journal to Grelin and accept Senir's Observations
Turn in Bring Back the Mug to Nori Pridedrift
Turn in A Refugee's Quandary to Felix Whindlebolt
Turn in Beginnings to Alamar Grimm
Turn in Call of Earth to Teo Hammerstorm and accept the next part
Accept In Favor of the Light from Branstock Khalder

tips.text: Priests: this sends you to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos for your first robe quest.

segments.t: Accept Grund and Gozwin from Grund Drokda

tips.text: New in Forever. Grund stands inside Anvilmar; his partner's camp is up the hill to the northwest.

segments.t: Complete Grund and Gozwin: Snow Leopard Prowler, Gozwin's Mechanic's Log

tips.text: The Snow Leopard Prowler is a single tougher cat at the camp. Pull it away from the tents before you loot the log.

segments.t: Drink the Earth Sapta at the Spirit Stone northwest of Anvilmar, talk to the Minor Manifestation of Earth and accept the last Call of Earth
Turn in Grund and Gozwin to Grund Drokda
Turn in Call of Earth to Teo Hammerstorm

tips.text: Teo gives you your Earth Totem. Train before you leave the valley.

segments.t: Visit your class trainer before leaving Coldridge

actions.label: Visit your class trainer before leaving Coldridge

segments.t: Turn in Senir's Observations to Mountaineer Thalos at the tunnel and accept the follow-up plus The Adventurer

tips.text: The Adventurer is a Forever camping quest. It sends you to Eric Brighthammer outside the Kharanos inn.

segments.t: Accept Supplies to Tannok from Hands Springsprocket

tips.text: Run through the tunnel to Kharanos now. Nothing else in the valley is worth going back for.
